newsitem.title: CHINA: Strong debut seen for Luthai 80 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Strong debut seen for Luthai 80 mln B shares.

text.p: China's Luthai Textile Joint Stock Co Ltd is expected to make a strong debut when it lists 80 million B shares in Shenzhen next week, brokers said on Friday.
Analysts said they expected Luthai shares to open at between HK$3.00 and HK$4.00 on its Tuesday debut, compared with the HK$1.93 offer price.
"For sure Luthai will not fall short of its offer price," an analyst at J&A Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin. "The market is performing strongly."
Analysts said the Luthai debut was likely to outperform that of the recently-listed Bengang Steel Plates Co Ltd because of improved market sentiment.
Bengang, which listed 400 million B shares last month, became the first B share firm to fall through its offer price on its debut.
However, analysts voiced concern over Luthai's long-term gains in light of the poor performance of China's textile industry.

Luthai completed an initial public offering earlier this month, giving a P/E ratio of 8.71 times based on forecast 1997 net profits, an official at chief domestic underwriter China Southern Securities said.
Luthai Textile, based in Zibo city in eastern Shandong province, will use the 150.32 million yuan net proceeds to expand coloured cloth spinning capacity, the company said in a listing announcement.

After the B share issue, Luthai will have 158.30 million outstanding shares, consisting of 58.30 million institutional shares, 20 million shares held by company staff and 80 million B shares, it said.
